lines.zh: 我在浅水里走，脚掌踩着沙子。
lines.en: I wade the shallows with my feet on the sand.

lines.zh: 河边的石头滑，我一步一停。
lines.en: The river stones are slick, so I stop at each step.

lines.zh: 我摇摇摆摆地走，姿态不太好。
lines.en: I waddle along with very little grace.

lines.zh: 沙滩上有鱼鳞，我顺着走。
lines.en: Fish scales on the sand, and I follow them.

lines.zh: 我张开大嘴，试了试河风。
lines.en: I open my big beak to taste the river wind.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，露出一片湿沙。
lines.en: The tide pulled back and left wet sand.

lines.zh: 我沿着河岸走，脖子一伸一缩。
lines.en: I pace the bank, neck stretching and drawing in.

lines.zh: 翅膀半张着，帮我在沙上平衡。
lines.en: Wings half spread to keep my balance on sand.

lines.zh: 前面有群小鱼，我加快脚步。
lines.en: A school of small fish ahead, so I hurry.

lines.zh: 水没过脚踝，凉得正好。
lines.en: Water up to my ankles, cool and just right.

lines.zh: 我走上沙丘，风把羽毛吹开。
lines.en: I climb the dune and the wind parts my feathers.

lines.zh: 河面亮得刺眼，我眯起眼。
lines.en: The river glare is harsh, so I narrow my eyes.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，怕踩到贝壳。
lines.en: I shift step by step, wary of shells.

lines.zh: 这片沙滩归我巡逻，别抢。
lines.en: This stretch of beach is mine to patrol.

lines.zh: 我把喙插进水里，捞了一下。
lines.en: I dip my beak in the water and scoop.

lines.zh: 风从海上来，我的羽毛立起来。
lines.en: Wind comes off the sea and lifts my feathers.

lines.zh: 我把嘴插进翅膀里，歇一会。
lines.en: I tuck my beak into my feathers for a rest.

lines.zh: 河水流着，我站着不动。
lines.en: The river runs on and I stand still.

lines.zh: 太阳晒得我喉囊发暖。
lines.en: The sun warms my throat pouch.

lines.zh: 风里有鱼的味道，我闻得出。
lines.en: There is fish on the wind; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀，水珠四散。
lines.en: I shake my wings and droplets fly.

lines.zh: 沙子钻进羽毛，有点磨人。
lines.en: Sand gets into my feathers and grates.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，打了个嗝。
lines.en: I stretch my neck and give a small belch.

lines.zh: 一群海鸥在叫，我不理它们。
lines.en: A flock of gulls cries and I ignore them.

lines.zh: 我数着河上的波纹，数不清。
lines.en: I count the ripples on the river and lose track.

lines.zh: 我的喉囊空着，可以装很多。
lines.en: My pouch is empty and can hold a great deal.

lines.zh: 芦苇在响，我转了下头。
lines.en: The reeds rustle and I turn my head.

lines.zh: 一只脚收进羽毛，我懒得换。
lines.en: One foot tucked into my feathers; I won't switch.

lines.zh: 沙滩很烫，我挪到阴影里。
lines.en: The sand is hot, so I shift into the shade.

lines.zh: 这时候没人来，正好发呆。
lines.en: Nobody comes at this hour, perfect for staring.

lines.zh: 你站在河边，鱼都在你脚下。
lines.en: You stand by the river with fish at your feet.

lines.zh: 我歪着头看你手里的东西。
lines.en: I tilt my head at whatever you are holding.

lines.zh: 你走近，我的嘴微微张开。
lines.en: As you come close, my beak opens a little.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在水面上，被我看见。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the water and I see it.

lines.zh: 你身上有鱼腥味，我很确定。
lines.en: You smell of fish; I am quite sure.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，看你会不会扔东西。
lines.en: I watch to see whether you will throw something.

lines.zh: 你不过来的话，我就走过去。
lines.en: If you won't come, then I will walk over.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛长在两侧，看得很全。
lines.en: My eyes sit wide apart, so I see it all.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我也退一步。
lines.en: You step back, and I step back too.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我的嘴就是这样。
lines.en: What are you laughing at? My beak is just like this.

lines.zh: 嘎！我的翅膀被打歪了。
lines.en: Squawk! My wing has been knocked crooked.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我喉囊都在抖。
lines.en: That hit set even my pouch trembling.

lines.zh: 羽毛落了满地，风一吹就走。
lines.en: Feathers lie everywhere and blow away.

lines.zh: 我退到水里，伤口碰到盐水。
lines.en: I back into the water and salt stings the wound.

lines.zh: 护甲只有一点，挡不了几下。
lines.en: One point of armor will not stop much.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，叫得断断续续。
lines.en: My beak hangs open and my calls break apart.

lines.zh: 疼得我站不住，坐进沙里。
lines.en: It hurts too much to stand, so I sit in the sand.

lines.zh: 血滴在沙上，很快被吸干。
lines.en: Blood drips on the sand and soaks in fast.

lines.zh: 八点生命，我还想再撑一会。
lines.en: Eight points of life, and I want to last a while.

lines.zh: 别打脖子，那里最软。
lines.en: Not the neck; that is the softest part.

lines.zh: 鱼！我闻到了，就在你手里。
lines.en: Fish! I smell it, right there in your hand.

lines.zh: 没有鱼的话，苹果我也肯吃。
lines.en: If there is no fish, an apple will do.

lines.zh: 你把鱼举高，我脖子不够长。
lines.en: You hold the fish high and my neck is too short.

lines.zh: 我张嘴接，别扔偏了。
lines.en: I open my beak; don't throw it wide.

lines.zh: 这条太小，还有更大的吗？
lines.en: This one is small; is there a bigger one?

lines.zh: 为了鱼，我可以走到你脚边。
lines.en: For fish I will walk right up to your feet.

lines.zh: 鱼鳞在太阳下亮，我盯住了。
lines.en: The scales shine in the sun and I fix on them.

lines.zh: 你放下，我就不客气了。
lines.en: Put it down and I will not hold back.

lines.zh: 我喉囊已经在动了。
lines.en: My pouch is already working.

lines.zh: 第二条鱼下肚，我就赖上你了。
lines.en: After the second fish I am yours for good.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚掌了，站稳点！
lines.en: You stepped on my foot; steady yourself!

lines.zh: 我被撞得侧过身，羽毛竖起。
lines.en: The bump turns me sideways and my feathers rise.

lines.zh: 这么大的鸟，你居然没看见？
lines.en: A bird this big, and you didn't see me?

lines.zh: 我的喙差点戳到你的腿。
lines.en: My beak nearly jabbed your leg.

lines.zh: 退后，我要理顺翅膀。
lines.en: Step back, I need to straighten my wings.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我嘎了一声。
lines.en: That knock forced a squawk out of me.

lines.zh: 你身上的水甩到我脸上了。
lines.en: You shook water right onto my face.

lines.zh: 我踉跄着退进浅水里。
lines.en: I stumble backwards into the shallows.

lines.zh: 沙滩就这么宽，让让吧。
lines.en: The beach is only so wide; make room.

lines.zh: 撞我之前，看看我有多宽。
lines.en: Before you bump me, note how wide I am.

lines.zh: 我叼着鱼去找她，脖子伸得很直。
lines.en: I carry a fish to her with my neck stretched straight.

lines.zh: 我们把喙碰在一起，咔的一声。
lines.en: Our beaks meet with a small clack.

lines.zh: 沙丘背风处，正适合安家。
lines.en: The lee of the dune is just right for a nest.

lines.zh: 她收下鱼，我就知道成了。
lines.en: She took the fish, so I know it is settled.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈子走，翅膀半开。
lines.en: I walk in a circle with my wings half open.

lines.zh: 我们一起守着这窝沙。
lines.en: Together we guard this nest of sand.

lines.zh: 她把头靠过来，我也靠过去。
lines.en: She leans her head in, and so do I.

lines.zh: 河风大，我们挨得紧一点。
lines.en: The river wind is strong, so we press closer.

lines.zh: 再过些天，就有蛋了。
lines.en: In a few days there will be eggs.

lines.zh: 这条鱼，是我送她的第一份礼。
lines.en: This fish is the first gift I give her.

lines.zh: 我一口叼起鱼，喉囊晃了晃。
lines.en: I scoop up the fish and my pouch wobbles.

lines.zh: 这块贝壳太滑，夹不住。
lines.en: This shell is too smooth to hold.

lines.zh: 我把树枝拖了两步，算了。
lines.en: I drag a branch two steps, then give up.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞着鱼，我说不了话。
lines.en: With fish in my beak I cannot speak.

lines.zh: 羽毛缠在脚上，我啄开它。
lines.en: A feather wrapped round my foot; I peck it loose.

lines.zh: 我叼起海草，甩到一边。
lines.en: I pick up seaweed and fling it aside.

lines.zh: 小鱼从嘴里滑出去了，真糟。
lines.en: The little fish slipped out of my beak; how annoying.

lines.zh: 我用喙把蛋推回窝里。
lines.en: I push the egg back into the nest with my beak.

lines.zh: 这根骨头挺沉，我放下了。
lines.en: This bone is heavy, so I set it down.

lines.zh: 捡到的都归我，别伸手。
lines.en: Whatever I pick up is mine; hands off.

lines.zh: 这一下我记着，河滩上再算。
lines.en: I will remember that blow, here on the flats.

lines.zh: 水里那个人影还在，我盯着。
lines.en: That shape in the water is still there; I watch it.

lines.zh: 谁动了我的窝？我找找看。
lines.en: Who touched my nest? I will find out.

lines.zh: 刚才那支箭是从那边来的。
lines.en: That arrow came from over there.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，发出低低的叫声。
lines.en: I open my beak and give a low call.

lines.zh: 这家伙比我小，我敢追。
lines.en: This one is smaller than me; I dare chase it.

lines.zh: 它抢我的鱼，我看见了。
lines.en: It stole my fish and I saw it.

lines.zh: 我锁定那道跑开的影子。
lines.en: I lock onto that shadow running off.

lines.zh: 别以为我只会站着看。
lines.en: Don't think I only stand and watch.

lines.zh: 惹我的，我都会还回去。
lines.en: Anyone who crosses me gets it back.

lines.zh: 我慢慢张开翅膀，显得更大。
lines.en: I spread my wings slowly to look bigger.

lines.zh: 脖子伸长，喙对准了它。
lines.en: Neck out, beak lined up on it.

lines.zh: 它跑，我就跟着转方向。
lines.en: It runs, and I turn to follow.

lines.zh: 沙子在我脚下，我准备冲。
lines.en: Sand under my feet, and I am set to charge.

lines.zh: 我在找一个能咬住的地方。
lines.en: I am looking for a spot to clamp onto.

lines.zh: 它的节奏乱了一下，机会来了。
lines.en: Its rhythm broke for a moment; there is my chance.

lines.zh: 我把喉囊鼓起来，吓它一跳。
lines.en: I puff my pouch to startle it.

lines.zh: 它再往前挪，我的喙就到了。
lines.en: One more shuffle forward and my beak arrives.

lines.zh: 翅膀张开，挡住它的退路。
lines.en: Wings spread, I block its way back.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚出一声，先礼后兵。
lines.en: A growl rolls from my throat: a fair warning.

lines.zh: 我的喙砸下去，沙子飞起来！
lines.en: My beak slams down and sand flies!

lines.zh: 这一夹，用尽了我的脖子。
lines.en: That clamp took all the strength in my neck.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇过去，它退了半步。
lines.en: My wing sweeps across and it falls back a step.

lines.zh: 我追着它跑了两步就停。
lines.en: I chase it two steps and then stop.

lines.zh: 它咬我一口，我啄它两下。
lines.en: It bites me once and I peck it twice.

lines.zh: 羽毛被扯掉几根，我不在乎。
lines.en: A few feathers torn out; I don't care.

lines.zh: 我护着窝，谁也别想靠近。
lines.en: I guard the nest; nobody gets near.

lines.zh: 打完这一下，我喘得厉害。
lines.en: After that blow I am panting hard.

lines.zh: 它跑了，我站在原地张着嘴。
lines.en: It fled, and I stand there with my beak open.

lines.zh: 一点攻击力，也能咬疼你。
lines.en: One point of attack can still sting.

lines.zh: 我在沙窝里啄开蛋壳。
lines.en: I peck my way out of the shell in a sand nest.

lines.zh: 河水的声音，是我听到的第一样。
lines.en: The sound of the river is the first thing I hear.

lines.zh: 羽毛还湿着，我站不起来。
lines.en: My feathers are wet and I cannot stand.

lines.zh: 母亲用喙把我往窝里推。
lines.en: Mother nudges me back into the nest with her beak.

lines.zh: 太阳晒热沙子，我暖了过来。
lines.en: The sun heats the sand and I warm up.

lines.zh: 我试着张嘴，只发出哑哑的气声。
lines.en: I try to call and only a dry wheeze comes out.

lines.zh: 这条河很长，我以后慢慢走。
lines.en: This river is long; I will walk it slowly.

lines.zh: 兄弟姐妹挤着我，窝太小了。
lines.en: My siblings press on me; the nest is too small.

lines.zh: 第一口鱼，是母亲吐给我的。
lines.en: My first fish came from mother's beak.

lines.zh: 风从河面来，我抖了抖绒毛。
lines.en: Wind comes off the river and I ruffle my down.

lines.zh: 羽毛一着就卷，我扑进水里。
lines.en: My feathers curl at a touch of flame, so I plunge in.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘上滚下去，嘴还张着。
lines.en: I roll down the dune with my beak still open.

lines.zh: 河水灌进喉囊，我抬不起头。
lines.en: River water fills my pouch and I cannot lift my head.

lines.zh: 沙被炸开，我摔出好远。
lines.en: The sand bursts apart and I am thrown far.

lines.zh: 箭扎进翅膀，我飞不起来了。
lines.en: An arrow is in my wing and I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 那股怪味让我站不稳，眼前发白。
lines.en: That strange reek makes me sway and my sight goes white.

lines.zh: 河里没鱼，我的喉囊一直空着。
lines.en: No fish in the river and my pouch stays empty.

lines.zh: 雷落在河面，我的羽毛全竖了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the river and every feather stands up.

lines.zh: 我掉进没有水的黑里，一直落。
lines.en: I fall into a black place with no water at all.
